Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Review agent: Codex PR-reviewer `/root`. The user assigned this session only to review PR #1899. This agent did not write the change. Test agent: `/root/local_tests`.

What looks good:

- The collection step reads all pages of reviews, comments and label events.
- The instructions require evidence of an independent review. They preserve independent reviews from agents that share an account.
- The planner receives only the PR numbers retained by the collection step.
- The decision file and PR body explain the change and the test limits. The body includes `Process change: yes`.

Local results:

The PR merged without conflicts with upstream/main `8719d8b7a028f0c93cc78fe32ccbfdf5297a0dca` in an isolated review worktree.
All commands ran locally in the foreground and completed. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p xtask --no-run` | Pass |
| `cargo test -p xtask` | 143 passed; 0 failed: 137 unit tests, 3 merge-ready tests, 3 review-artifact tests |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Pass |
| `git diff upstream/main --check` | Pass |

The gate dry-run selected unrelated upstream changes through the old merge base because the trial merge was not committed.
The explicit xtask checks above covered this PR. The full batch gate was not run.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- The tests inspect instruction text. They do not test live GitHub classification or an agent's execution of the workflow.
- This PR does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks or stock simulation. Safety-tier mutation checks do not apply.
- No mutation tests were run during this review. No goldens or UI files changed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
